Super Vegetable Beef Stew

In a large dutch oven over medium heat, warm (1) oil. Add (3) meat, onion, garlic and saute until meat is no longer pink, about 10 minutes.

Add (3) celery, carrots, bell pepper, and mix well.

Add (11) stock, tomato juice, tomatoes, water, chili powder, soy sauce, Worcester sauce, thyme, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

Add (2) corn and peas. simmer uncovered until flavors are blended and meat tender. 15 minutes or so.

Remove Bay leaf and discard.

Ladle into Bowls and Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

*Serves 6

  • 1Tablesppon Vegtable Oil
  • 1 and 1/2 lbs steak cut into 1 inch cubes
  • 1 yellow onion
  • 2 cloves garlic
  • 2 stalks celery

  • 3 cups beef stock

  • 1 bay leaf

  • 1 cup peas (fresh or frozen)
  • Freshly grated Parmesan cheese for topping
